_: The King's war on a great house (war.js; CK3's war goal, Total War's campaign against a faction, its capital last). minCompanies: the smallest host the captains send against a town (a host in the King's seat of twice that or more leaves half at home). regroup: seasons the captains wait after a siege came to nothing before ordering the next town. join: the King's envoy asking a house to join the war (decrees.json join): chance = (favour - floor) / span, plus atWar if the house already fights the foe, less likingWeight for each point its lord likes the foe's lord, at most most; a house sworn to the crown comes at sworn; a house bound to the foe (pact or marriage) or whose lord likes the foe's lord friendly or more refuses and warns the foe, whose next town raises warnLevy. A house that joins is under oath for seasons (it sends its men with each siege, campaigns.js); the King may ask a house again after again seasons. retaliate: the house at war strikes back every every seasons (characters.js retaliate): its own host of host companies of kinds on the King's town nearest its lands when it has hostMin companies or more and its lord is not craven, else men without banners raid that town.

sides._: When the King declares war every other great house takes a side (war.js sides; Mac 2026-11-16: 'when war is declared, its not done in isolation, the houses take a side, some commit men, some don't, some join the other side'). With the crown: its chance to join (as join) plus bandwagon times the crown's odds of winning less the foe's; with the foe: a house bound to it or whose lord likes its lord, else a house cold to the crown (under the cooling band) with chance against plus bandwagon times the foe's odds, more by the realm's alarm (alarmWeight per point); else it waits. commit: the share of its companies a house sends (sworn, eager, grudging by its chance). likely: a forecast's line between 'likely' and 'may'.

upkeep._: What the crown's wars cost each season (war.js upkeep; Total War's upkeep, Mac 2026-11-16: 'its very cheap'): every great house at war with the crown, in gold (x100 crowns): the first base, each further one step more than the last (two wars: base + base*(1+step)). Paid from the treasury each season; said in the chronicle once a year.
